description: What the program-paths suite must notice: a helper program started by a bare name, found in the workspace or on an entry of PATH that is not absolute, or started without the search variable; a shell that does not get the variable as the owner had it.

mutations.name: R1
mutations.what: an entry of PATH that is not absolute is read

mutations.name: R2
mutations.what: a folder named like the program counts

mutations.name: R3
mutations.what: a file that may not be executed counts

mutations.name: R4
mutations.what: a program below the workspace is taken

patches.old: if (workspace !== null && isWithin(workspace, await real(file))) continue;

mutations.name: R5
mutations.what: links are not followed when the workspace is compared

patches.old: if (workspace !== null && isWithin(workspace, await real(file))) continue;

mutations.name: R6
mutations.what: a workspace that holds the home folder takes the programs away

patches.old: if (workspace !== null && isWithin(workspace, await real(os.homedir()))) workspace = null;

mutations.name: R7
mutations.what: programOnPath forgets the workspace

mutations.name: R8
mutations.what: the search variable is not set by the process

mutations.name: R9
mutations.what: a shell gets the variable the process set

mutations.name: R10
mutations.what: a shell loses the variable of the owner

mutations.name: R11
mutations.what: a helper program does not get the variable

mutations.name: G1
mutations.what: the GitHub capabilities start gh by its name

mutations.name: G2
mutations.what: the GitHub capabilities forget the workspace

mutations.name: G3
mutations.what: the GitHub capabilities leave the variable out

mutations.name: G4
mutations.what: the GitHub capabilities do not say that gh is missing

patches.old: if(!program)throw fail('missing_gh','GitHub CLI gh is not installed or not on PATH.');

mutations.name: L1
mutations.what: github_read and github_action start gh by its name

mutations.name: L2
mutations.what: github_read and github_action forget the workspace

mutations.name: L3
mutations.what: github_read and github_action leave the variable out

mutations.name: O1
mutations.what: the draft pull request starts gh by its name

mutations.name: O2
mutations.what: the draft pull request forgets the workspace

mutations.name: O3
mutations.what: the draft pull request leaves the variable out

mutations.name: K1
mutations.what: killTree starts taskkill by its name

mutations.name: K2
mutations.what: the process table starts taskkill by its name

mutations.name: K3
mutations.what: a shell of the agent gets the variable of the Hub

mutations.name: K4
mutations.what: a terminal gets the variable of the Hub

mutations.name: K5
mutations.what: a hook gets the variable of the Hub

patches.old: kind: 'exec', shell: null, environment: shellSearch(scrubEnv(this.env, { secrets: this.secrets() })) };
patches.new: kind: 'exec', shell: null, environment: scrubEnv(this.env, { secrets: this.secrets() }) };

mutations.name: D1
mutations.what: Docker is asked by its name

mutations.name: D2
mutations.what: a run in Docker is started by its name

mutations.name: D3
mutations.what: a run in Docker is ended by its name

mutations.name: D4
mutations.what: Docker forgets the workspace

mutations.name: W1
mutations.what: the diff of a review starts git by its name

mutations.name: W2
mutations.what: the Git runner forgets the workspace

mutations.name: P1

mutations.name: P2
mutations.what: the index forgets the workspace

mutations.name: P3
mutations.what: the AST worker starts Python by its name

mutations.name: P4
mutations.what: the AST worker forgets the workspace

mutations.name: P5
mutations.what: the index leaves the variable out

mutations.name: P6
mutations.what: the AST worker leaves the variable out

mutations.name: S1
mutations.what: a language server is started by its name

mutations.name: S2
mutations.what: a language server may come from the workspace

mutations.name: S3
mutations.what: a language server is started without the variable

mutations.name: C2
mutations.what: the launch record reads an entry of PATH that is not absolute

mutations.name: H1
